## Objective
- Build a playable 3D pixel-art RPG in `index.html` centered on knight progression, regional bosses, loot, property management, and kingship.
- Add merchants, quests, level-based enemies and zones, and make becoming king difficult.

## Requirements
- The game should be 3D, not 2D.
- Reduce on-screen text and provide on-screen menu buttons.
- Add merchants and quests; make kingship hard to attain; have enemies and zones scale by level.

## Decisions
- Keep the game as a standalone `index.html` with no external assets.
- Use custom WebGL low-poly geometry for the 3D scene.
- Gate regions by level and prior guardian victories; require substantial progression to claim the crown.

- Added a traveling merchant with level-gated gear and potion purchases.
- Added three quests with progress tracking and claimable rewards.
- Raised kingship requirements to level 10, all three guardians defeated, 250 renown, a Stone Keep, and all quests claimed.

## Objective
- Build a playable 3D pixel-art RPG in `index.html` centered on knight progression, regional bosses, loot, property management, and kingship.
- Add merchants, quests, level-scaled enemies and zones, and make becoming king difficult.

## Requirements
- The game should be 3D, not 2D.
- Reduce on-screen text and provide on-screen menu buttons.
- Add merchants and quests; make kingship hard to attain; have enemies and zones scale by level.

## Decisions
- Keep the game as a standalone `index.html` with no external assets.
- Use custom WebGL low-poly geometry for the 3D scene.
- Gate regions by level and prior guardian victories; require substantial progression to claim the crown.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added icon controls for combat, interaction, skills, pack, holdings, map, merchant, and quests.
- Implemented custom WebGL 3D terrain, scenery, player, and enemy models.
- Added level-scaled enemies and region ranges, plus traveling merchant stock gated by player level.
- Added three tracked quests with claimable gold and renown rewards.
- Raised kingship requirements to level 10, all three guardians defeated, 250 renown, a Stone Keep, and all quests claimed.
- Updated guardian quest progress and unlocks; added region-specific entry requirements and lock indicators.
- Updated king progress meter and combat hint to show the revised requirements and enemy level.

### Active
- Validate JavaScript syntax and game systems; check region/map messaging and fix any runtime, progression, or UI inconsistencies.

### Blocked
- Browser verification was previously blocked because Chromium was unavailable: `Browser "chromium" is not installed; expected executable at /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome.`

## Next Move
1. Check JavaScript syntax and determine whether browser tooling is available.
2. Review map/region descriptions and lock messaging against `regionRequirement()` and kingship requirements.
3. Test combat, quest completion and rewards, merchant purchases, property ownership, and kingship; fix progression bugs.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game, including UI, gameplay systems, quests, merchant, region gates, and WebGL renderer.

## Important Context
- Highcourt entry requires level 10, all three guardians defeated, and 180 renown.
- Claiming kingship additionally requires 250 renown, a Stone Keep, and all quests claimed.
- Browser-based verification has not been confirmed after the latest edits.
